acceptance: A check on the core PR, or on the site against the candidate core tree, fails when a deleted or renamed core path is linked from a site page; shown against a seeded dead link.
description: A core PR that deletes a file linked from a site-owned page passes core CI and site CI, then fails the site build gate at deploy. Observed on 2026-10-27: after core PR 3545 merged, the site converter rejected development/adr/adr-sqlglot-use-and-non-use.md:218 (link to the deleted scripts/generate_compat_docs.py), and production deploys 40602921344 and 40603742160 failed at the build gate (nothing deployed; fixed in site PR 74). Site CI only builds against bundles that already merged, and core's retired link checker no longer covers site pages.
